name: VIVEKANAND
about: Vivekanand Cotspin Limited engages in cotton processing and yarn manufacturing in India and internationally. The company's products include raw cotton bales, cotton yarn waste, cotton seeds, and cotton yarn, including both combed compact yarn and carded compact yarn. The company operates in two primary areas, cotton ginning and spinning. Its ginning process includes separating cotton fibers from seeds, and its spinning process includes converting cotton fibers into yarn. Its products are used by textile mills for weaving and knitting fabrics. The company caters to both domestic and international markets. The company exports its products to Bangladesh, China, Egypt, Vietnam, and Portugal. It also operates solar power plant. Vivekanand Cotspin Limited was founded in 1999 and is based in Mehsana, India.
